grammar.title: In addition to with 除了...还/也
grammar.pattern: 除了 + A，(主语) + 还/也 + B
grammar.explanation: 除了 (chúle) here means "in addition to, besides" rather than "except" — paired with 还 or 也 in the second clause, it adds more information on top of what's mentioned. This differs from 除了...以外，都, which means "except for".

grammar.title: Finally with 终于
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 终于 + 动词短语 + 了
grammar.explanation: 终于 (zhōngyú) means "finally, at last" — it marks the end of a long wait or effort, usually paired with 了 at the end of the sentence. It carries a sense of relief or achievement after something difficult or long-awaited.

sentences.zh: 首先，我们要确定目标，然后开始工作。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒmen yào quèdìng mùbiāo, ránhòu kāishǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.en: First we need to set a goal, then start working.

sentences.zh: 首先介绍一下儿自己，然后回答问题。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuxiān jièshào yīxiàr zìjǐ, ránhòu huídá wèntí.
sentences.en: First introduce yourself a bit, then answer questions.
First wash your hands, then eat.

sentences.zh: 这个工作至少需要三天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò zhìshǎo xūyào sān tiān.
sentences.en: This job needs at least three days.
You should at least tell him.

sentences.zh: 我们至少要练习一个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhìshǎo yào liànxí yī gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: We need to practice for at least an hour.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yóu tā fùzé.
sentences.en: This matter is handled by him.
